title: Partnerships Lead, UK&I
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Partnerships Lead to build and scale Tandem Health's strategic partnerships across the UK. You will play a key role in accelerating our growth by identifying and securing high-impact partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and healthtech platforms. You'll own the full partnership lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and building senior relationships through to negotiating agreements, launching partnerships and driving commercial value. Working closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams, you'll help unlock new routes to market, expand our distribution and establish Tandem as a leading AI partner to UK healthcare. What You Will Do Own and execute Tandem's UK partnerships strategy, identifying the relationships and channels that will have the greatest impact on our growth. Identify and secure strategic partnerships across the UK healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and specialist clinic networks. Develop relationships with EHR/EMR providers, digital health platforms and complementary technology businesses to unlock new distribution and integration opportunities. Originate and manage partnership opportunities end-to-end, from initial outreach and business development through to commercial negotiations, contracting and launch. Develop compelling partnership propositions and commercial models that create value for both Tandem and its partners. Drive tangible outcomes from partnerships, including revenue generation, customer acquisition, clinician adoption and market expansion. Work closely with sales, product, project delivery, medical operations and marketing teams to ensure successful implementation and maximise the value of strategic partnerships. Represent Tandem at industry events and conferences, building our profile and network across the UK healthcare market. Monitor market developments and identify new opportunities to strengthen Tandem's competitive position and accelerate growth. What You Bring Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ideally within healthcare, healthtech or enterprise technology. Strong understanding of the UK healthcare landscape, including NHS structures, private healthcare and the wider digital health ecosystem. An established network of relevant industry contacts, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior decision-makers. Demonstrable track record of originating and closing complex, high-value commercial partnerships. Experience developing partnership strategies, identifying new routes to market and creating scalable commercial opportunities. Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, develop business cases and negotiate sustainable agreements. Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging C-suite executives and senior healthcare leaders. Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership and ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Collaborative approach and ability to bring together cross-functional teams to deliver results. Genuine interest in AI, healthcare innovation and transforming how healthcare is delivered. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with Head of Sales UK&I Sales Demo with Country Director UK&I Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Benefits Competitive salary & company stock options 30 days/year of paid vacation £800 wellness budget per year Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy Mental health support through our partner Mindler Pension program Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties) An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering. We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: About Delinea: Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure. Strategic Account Manager Summary: This remote position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into Strategic Accounts, FTSE 100 and global enterprise accounts. This is a senior individual contributor role for an elite enterprise hunter — someone who thrives at board level, navigates complex multi-stakeholder cycles, and isn’t satisfied closing anything less than transformational deals. You’ll own some of Delinea’s most strategically significant new logo opportunities, engaging CISOs and C-suite executives at the UK’s largest organisations. What You'll Do: You won’t be working in isolation. This role is supported by a dedicated senior SDR, a mature and active channel organisation, and a sophisticated marketing function — so you can focus your energy where it matters most: winning. metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts) Collaborate with sales teams to identify and grow opportunities within territory What You'll Bring: 10+ years of experience successfully selling ROI-driven, Enterprise-Wide SaaS/Subscription/Cloud Applications to C-level decision makers Experience selling Professional Services as part of outcome-based solution selling Ability to demonstrate software offerings at a detailed level, develop innovative value propositions to maximize sales revenue, and negotiate and close under time and objective pressure Demonstrated success in title: Senior Data Engineer
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. The Role We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer . Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS. You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on. You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on. You will: Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain. Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog. Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents. Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10. Responsibilities Data Ingestion Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break. Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources. Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data. Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Platform Maintenance Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights. Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage). Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments. Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow. Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills. Monitoring & Alerting Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact. Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to. Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems. Supporting Expansion Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion. Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone. Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow. Requirements Must haves Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code. AWS or GCP experience. Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences. Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4. Terraform experience. Bonus points Experience with time-series data at scale. Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse). Experience in energy or climate tech. Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups. Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering. We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end. Benefits & Perks Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year. Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Home working and wellbeing budgets: Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. Interview Process We move fast. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Member of Technical Staff
description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed , co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it. You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week. What we're looking for We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not. What we're actually screening for: You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed. You build genuinely good interfaces , and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires. You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship. Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build. You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs. Signals we like, none of them required: founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain. This is probably not for you if You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch. You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning. You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane. What you get Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs. These results caught the attention of The Financial Times , as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards , jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore. This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth! Your Next Role We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability. You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps. Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance. This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising. What You’ll Do 1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales. Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand. Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media. Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign. Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance. Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive. Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation. 2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates. Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows. Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently. 3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list. Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop. Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends. Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified. Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees. 4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance. Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense. Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate. Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them. Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance. 5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review. Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback. Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners. Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications. Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic. Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly. 6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively. Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content. Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use. Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels. Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content. Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role. 7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house. Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume. Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time. Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly. Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate. 7. Measure and Improve Performance You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic. You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns. Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program. Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment. Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership. Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format. Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches. How You’ll Succeed You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution. You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve. You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content. You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment. You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone. You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce. You introduce structure without slowing down execution. You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns. You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align. You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes. What You Bring Required 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability. Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for. DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category. Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it. Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house. Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships. Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them. Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved. Strongly preferred Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound. Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta. Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time. Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent. Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories. title: Account Manager - SMB
description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Role Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed. This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement. As an Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad. Our European base is growing quickly, and this role is for someone who can work with customers in German, French or Spanish as well as English. Holding a renewal or pricing conversation in a customer’s own language builds trust faster, and at this end of the market that speed matters. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in a high-velocity environment and wants genuine ownership of customer outcomes, with a clear path into more strategic account management as Hiya continues to scale across Europe. What You’ll Do Own a portfolio of 300+ SMB accounts across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for renewals and expansion Manage your European accounts in German, French or Spanish as well as English Triage your book daily - identify which accounts need intervention and which are healthy enough to run digitally Run proactive outreach to at-risk accounts before they become churn conversations Identify natural expansion signals - usage growth, new teams, new use cases and convert them into upsell opportunities Forecast portfolio performance and maintain accurate CRM records Surface patterns from your book of business that help Sales, Product, and Support improve how Hiya serves SMB customers Balance short-term renewal pressure with longer-term account health, making clear tradeoffs under volume What We Are Looking For 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a commercial SaaS role Must have - Business-level German, French or Spanish - confident holding renewal, pricing, and expansion conversations in that language Demonstrated ownership of renewals, expansions, or quota Commercial instinct - able to spot a growth opportunity, build a case for it, and close it without heavy support Clear, direct communication with customers and internal stakeholders Comfortable working independently in an environment where not every process is fully defined You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have Experience managing SMB or Mid-Market customers Experience working across UK and European markets More than one of German, French or Spanish, or an additional European language Experience balancing personalised customer engagement with scale Exposure to conversation intelligence, caller ID, or communications technology Role details Status: Full-time Type: Hybrid Location: London, United Kingdom Travel: Up to 25% Department: Sales – Customer Success Reports to: Sr. Manager: Customer Success, UK & EU Come Work With Us! We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career. We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us! Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software. The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software. Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities. Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance. Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements. Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms. Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments. Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement. Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop. Required Qualifications BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline. Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment. Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle. Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes. Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies. Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling. Desirable Qualifications Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes. Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners. title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Program Management Team Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake. As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products. 🧠 Your day-to-day Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans. Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward. Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery. Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions. Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change. Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams. Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation. Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone. Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions. Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities. Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability. 🙌 You should apply if: You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams. You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products. You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution. You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes. You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information. You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution. You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions. You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone. You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences. You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools. Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable. A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: This is a full-time role based in our London office. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes) Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes) Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours) Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
description: <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">A different kind of organisation</span></h3> <ul> <li>High trust, transparency, and autonomy</li> <li>Small teams, high ownership, flat structures</li> <li>Radical compensation transparency</li> <li>Sense of ownership in collective success</li> <li>Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">The role</span></h3> <p>As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What the work looks like</span></h3> <p>We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:</p> <ul> <li>Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.</li> <li>Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.</li> <li>Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.</li> <li>Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.</li> </ul> <p>The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll do</span></h3> <h4>Frame Problems & Propose Solutions</h4> <ul> <li>Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.</li> <li>Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.</li> <li>Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.</li> </ul> <h4>Lead Through Technical Excellence</h4> <ul> <li>Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.</li> <li>Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.</li> <li>Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.</li> </ul> <h4>Influence, Advise, and align</h4> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.</li> <li>Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams</li> <li>Converge competing priorities into a path forward.</li> <li>Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.</li> </ul> <h4>Operate Across Technology Domains</h4> <p>Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. description: <h2><strong>Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>One Model is seeking a passionate <strong>Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant</strong> to help us scale our market presence in EMEA and bridge the gap between deep HR data capability, Workforce Intelligence, AI Measurement and Transformation,  and strategic business value.</p> <p>With customers and staff around the world, One Model offers a complete workforce intelligence platform along with a cutting-edge AI Impact evaluation tool.  Our products feature cloud-hosted data orchestration and advanced visualization and analytics tools all controllable via AI interfaces. Our platforms enable companies to unlock the real value of their HR and AI usage  data from the lens of the workforce.</p> <p><strong>This isn't your standard, script-reading sales demonstration role.</strong> We aren't looking for a "demo expert" who only knows which buttons to click, nor are we looking for someone with extensive People Analytics or HR experience.</p> <p><strong>The ideal fit:</strong> You are a proven pre-sales consultant who loves being a part of the sales process. You are able to quickly learn our products and basic people analytics concepts so that you can establish yourself as a knowledgeable trusted advisor in the sales process. </li> <li><strong>Gets it Done: </strong>You get it done, quickly and correctly.  You aren’t afraid to jump into the deep end and absorb as much as you can as fast as you can. You know each demonstration is an opportunity to grow and improve. </li> <li><strong>Not Afraid to Sell: </strong>You understand that this role is a critical part of the sales process and as such, you are able to build excitement about the One Model products and clearly explain its value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Natural Charisma & Presence:</strong> You are an exceptional communicator who commands a room or a web call. You genuinely enjoy meeting new people, building rapport quickly, and reading an audience to adjust your presentation style on the fly.</li> <li><strong>The Storyteller & Translator:</strong> You can develop a people analytics mindset, but your real superpower is translation. You can confidently discuss advanced analytics, metrics development, and system adoption with CHROs, HR leaders, AI Transformational Officers just as easily as you can discuss data logic with IT and Technical Buyers buyers.</li> <li><strong>Thrives in Momentum:</strong> You are adaptable, comfortable with a fast-paced scale-up environment, and can manage your time effectively when juggling multiple priorities.</li> <li><strong>What This Role Is NOT:</strong> This is a consultative, high customer-facing pre-sales role, NOT a backend data analytics or engineering position, nor is it a post-sales consulting role. This is not an applied People Analytics role, nor does it involve coding or data architecture work. </li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> We are a remote organization, supporting our employees to work from home. Ideally, you will be located near London, but we will consider candidates in the UK, followed by candidates in continental Europe. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Schedule: Hours of operations may vary depending on business needs. This role does provide some support for Account Executives located in the Eastern Time Zone in the US. As such, there will be situations where you will be expected to respond to Slack messages and support calls into the evening hours (London time). </strong></p> <h3><strong>Want to skip the line and guarantee your application gets reviewed?</strong></h3> <p>The "Show Us Your Spark" Video Challenge:</p> <p>While this video is optional, candidates who submit a video will be heavily prioritized and fast-tracked straight to the interview round. We are looking for people who can command a room, so this is your chance to stand out.</p> <p>We don't want a long, dry, feature-by-feature software demo. Instead, record a quick 2-to-3-minute video (using Loom, Zoom, or your phone) answering one of the prompts below:</p> <ul> <li>The 2-Minute Pitch. Pitch us your favorite app or tool on your phone right now. You have 2 minutes to make us want to download it immediately.</li> </ul> <p>The Golden Rule: Keep it under 3 minutes. If it feels like a dry, robotic corporate slide-read, you're doing it wrong! We aren’t grading your video editing or lighting; we are looking for your natural charisma, clarity, and ability to keep an audience engaged. Have fun with it.</p> <h4><strong>How to Submit Your Video:</strong></h4> <p>Please email your video file or link (Loom, YouTube, Drive, etc.) directly to ----- with the subject line: [Your Name] - Solutions Consultant Video Entry. Ensure your standard application is also submitted through our job board.</p> <h3><strong>We Support You As An Individual By</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Fostering a friendly, inclusive, respectful workplace culture.</li> <li>Supporting flexible work options, including 100% remote work and flexible hours.</li> <li>Coaching and development through our "Growing Together" conversations.</li> <li>Generous compensation, benefits, and professional mental health support (EAP).</li> </ul> <p><em>At One Model, we see the immense value of a diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply for the role even if you don't think you check every single box.</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£100,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£115,000 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. </p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them.</p> <p>That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work hybrid from our UK office in London. You will need the existing right to work in the UK; we are not able to sponsor a visa for this role. </p> <p>You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline:</strong> Make our existing ticket-to-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows.</li> <li><strong>Close the loop across the SDLC:</strong> Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge.</li> <li><strong>Prototype fast, then harden:</strong> Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Run AI in production properly:</strong> Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM-as-a-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time-to-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership.</li> <li><strong>Make autonomy safe:</strong> Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low-risk, easily verified work runs hands-off.</li> <li><strong>Lead AI-native engineering by example:</strong> Set the bar for AI-augmented engineering across the organization. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>Life at THG Beauty</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Analyst - Customer (Beauty) at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>As Senior Analyst in the Beauty Customer team, you will own analytical work that helps THG’s Beauty division understand and grow its customer base. Working across acquisition, retention, CRM, marketing and loyalty, you will build the analysis, models and insight that enable the business to make better decisions about how it acquires and retains customers. You are expected to work largely independently — owning complex analytical problems end-to-end.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a <strong>Senior Analyst — Customer (Beauty)</strong></span><span data-contrast="auto">, you will: </span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":1,"335551620":1}"> </span></p> <p><strong>Customer Analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own analytical projects across the customer lifecycle — acquisition, retention, CRM, loyalty, marketing performance and personalisation</li> <li>Build customer segmentations, cohort analyses and behavioural models that the business can act on</li> <li>Analyse marketing channel performance — understanding what drives efficient acquisition</li> <li>Support development of the Beauty customer KPI framework</li> <li>Contribute to marketing mix modelling (MMM) — providing customer and channel inputs, and connecting MMM outputs back to customer-level acquisition and retention decisions</li> <li>Synthesise quantitative data with qualitative insight (customer research, surveys, feedback) to build a rounded view of customer behaviour</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write and maintain SQL queries and analytical scripts — producing accurate, well-documented analysis</li> <li>Work with the Engineering team to understand the customer data model</li> <li>Build dashboards and reports that communicate customer performance clearly</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Present findings to the Customer Lead and Beauty stakeholders — translating complex analysis into clear business recommendations</li> <li>Manage ad hoc analytical requests — prioritising effectively and delivering reliably</li> <li>Coach the Customer Analyst — sharing knowledge and providing feedback</li> <li>Build strong working relationships across Beauty, Marketing, Brand and Data Engineering — managing stakeholder expectations and competing priorities proactively</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience (typically 3+ years) in customer analytics, CRM or marketing analytics</li> <li>Strong SQL skills — comfortable building complex analytical queries</li> <li>Experience with customer segmentation, cohort analysis or lifecycle analytics</li> <li>Strong storytelling — able to communicate complex analysis clearly to non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Proven ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership</li> <li>Experience with ecommerce analytics — conversion, funnel and site performance metrics</li> <li>Skilled at synthesising quantitative data with qualitative insight to form a complete view of customer behaviour</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management — able to build trust and manage competing priorities across functions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in beauty, lifestyle, fashion or e-commerce environments</li> <li>Exposure to marketing mix modelling (MMM) or econometric approaches to marketing measurement</li> <li>Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms</li> <li>Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tooling</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Good Looks Like at This Level</strong></p> <p>At THG, we expect everyone to demonstrate behaviours that match their level. Here is what that looks like in this role:</p> <ul> <li>Operates largely independently — owns complex customer analytics end-to-end</li> <li>Deep expertise in customer analytics — the go-to person for customer behaviour, acquisition and retention questions</li> <li>Coaches the Customer Analyst — actively developing team capability</li> <li>Accountable for own targets — delivers high-quality analysis with minimal supervision</li> <li>Understands how customer analytics connects to commercial outcomes — CLV, retention rate, acquisition cost</li> <li>Makes pragmatic decisions on analytical approach — balancing rigour with speed</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access to our subsidised on-site dentist.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.</li> <li>Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Engineering
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role Legora has grown from 40 to more than 900 people in 18 months. During that time, we reached $100M ARR, tripled our valuation in five months, and continued expanding into new markets around the world. Our Talent Acquisition function is now entering its next chapter. The processes, standards, and hiring approach that support our next phase of growth are being built today, which you’ll play a significant part in. You'll work closely with senior leaders from day one and play a key role in shaping how Legora hires and scales. What you’ll do Product velocity depends on having the right engineering and technical talent in place, fast, and at a high bar. As a Talent Partner, you will own that directly. You are not a support function for the Engineering team. You bring genuine craft to how technical hiring gets done, and you're accountable for the quality and pace of the people who build Legora's product. You will own end-to-end hiring across engineering in UK&I, working closely with senior leaders who are genuinely invested in recruiting, trusted to make high-impact decisions on hiring and team composition. Specifically, you will: Own full-cycle recruitment across UK&I, partnering closely with hiring managers to define role scope, success profiles, and hiring strategies aligned to business priorities. Help shape how Talent operates at Legora, contributing beyond hiring to process design, programs, tooling, and broader People initiatives. Build and nurture proactive talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, ensuring we stay ahead of demand rather than reacting to it. Run structured, data-informed hiring processes that balance quality, pace, and consistency while maintaining a high bar for talent. Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation through to offer, acting as a trusted and credible ambassador for Legora throughout.
