title: Commercial Director
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results. Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role. What You'll Own Sales strategy and structure Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve Data and performance management Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it Process, structure, and scalability Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount Team leadership and org design Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well Global and remote team leadership Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here Exec partnership and GTM planning Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic Who Will Thrive in This Role Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist. Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter. Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability. People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate. Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap. Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter. Compensation, Benefits & Workplace Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success. Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it. 25 days of holidays Enhanced parental leave. Hardware of your choice. Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more). Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Mid-level Software Engineer</strong> at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.</p> <p>This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.</p> <p>Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.</p> <p><strong>Teams we are hiring for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core Equity</strong> — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.</li> <li><strong>Workflows & Automation</strong> — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.</li> <li><strong>Reporting</strong> — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.</li> <li><strong>Tax</strong> — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.</li> </ul> title: (Senior) Account Executive - Future Opportunities
description: <p>Weekly office requirement: Mon/Tues/Thurs weekly</p> <p>At GWI, we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an impact. Those values are what got us where we are today, and they’re a big part of what we look for in our people.<br>While we’re not actively hiring for this role right now, we’re keen to connect with Senior Account Executives for future opportunities at GWI. If you’re interested in working with us but haven’t quite spotted the perfect role yet, we’d love you to join our proactive talent community. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <h2>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h2> <p><br>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:<br>👉 Experience in SaaS or Subscription/licensing sales, especially closing business in large and complex corporate accounts.<br>👉 Ability to apply strategic thinking and sales skills to align technology solutions with complex, multi-stakeholder business problems.<br>👉 Follow MEDD(P)ICC sales methodology to qualify opportunities and progress deals through the pipeline.<br>👉  Experience using Salesforce to manage business (sales-cycle, pipeline,<br>forecasting, etc.).<br>👉  Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas<br>clearly and succinctly<br>👉  You are a hunter who sees the value of outbound prospecting to grow your own<br>sales pipeline, in addition to inbound leads<br>👉  Ability to reach and develop relationships with C-level executives<br>👉 Have experience working in a start/scale-up environment</p> <p>Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <h2><strong>Our benefits</strong></h2> <p>Great benefits make a big difference. Not just to employees, but to the whole vibe of a business. That’s why when you work for us, you’ll enjoy a full spectrum of generous perks, rewards and office benefits.</p> <ul> <li>Competitve annual leave (excluding bank holidays) and December holiday office closure days on top</li> <li>Flexitime</li> <li>Early finishes on Fridays (4:30pm weekly, and 1pm during summer)</li> <li>Work from Anywhere in the world - up to 15 days</li> <li>Hybrid home/office working</li> <li>Latest tech equipment + WFH office budget</li> <li>A genuine commitment to mental and physical health, with a range of content, tools, and perks to help you look after your wellbeing</li> <li>OneGWI - the team that focuses on D&I in the workplace</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Who we are</strong></h1> <p>GWI was founded with the knowledge that understanding your audience is really important for business. When you know who you’re speaking to and why, you can create content and campaigns that stand out to the people that matter.</p> <p>Through our global online survey, we gather data on the behaviour and perceptions of consumers across the world. This provides businesses with deep, actionable insights on their audience, revealed from data they trust.</p> <p>It’s been going well, too. Since launching in 2009, we’ve become one of the UK’s fastest growing target audience companies. We’re not about to stop growing any time soon. As a business, we’re on a mission to re-engineer data-driven marketing, and we’re on the lookout for talented people to join us.</p> <h2><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h2> <p>Imagine if our data came from just one kind of person. We’d get a very nuanced view of the world. And we definitely wouldn’t have got off the ground as a business.</p> <p>Although things certainly aren’t perfect, we live in a society where differences are increasingly celebrated – so we’d expect nothing else from our teams.  In fact, the GWI office is as diverse as our global data, it’s really important to us that it stays that way.  This is a place to feel at home, express yourself freely and make your mark.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#LI-DNI</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The product V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . title: Senior People Partner - Content
description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most. We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders. You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews. Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on: Strategic Trusted advisor to your leaders : You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters. Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be. Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve : You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion. Fully embedded in your team : You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully. Catching things early : You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct. Org design : You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage. Talent management : You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming. Learning & development : You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed. Reward : You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible. Performance : You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too. Hands up for the bigger stuff : You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time. Tactical Employee Relations (ER) : Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally. Embedding people products : Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis. Data : Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use. Wellbeing support : 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.</em></p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Infrastructure Software & Automation</strong></h3> <ul> of infrastructure management</li> <li>Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Provisioning & Lifecycle Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management</li> <li>Automate infrastructure bring-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems</li> <li>Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems</li> <li>Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Reliability & Observability</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure</li> <li>Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues</li> <li>Translate recurring title: VP, Strategic Finance
description: Team: Finance (G&A) Reports to: Chief Financial Officer Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed About Nivoda Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses. Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started. We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players. Why this role & why now You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it. What you will own Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve. Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them. Corporate finance. description: The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that. Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection. Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases. Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows. Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions. Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios. Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy. What we’re looking for Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement. Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter. Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction. You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information. You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products. title: Solutions Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p>We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to join us on a permanent basis. <br><br>Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. </p> <p>You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like.<strong> <br> </strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing </strong></p> <ul> <li>Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we want from you </strong></p> <ul> <li>Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. </li> </ul> <p><strong>If you know some of this, even better </strong></p> <ul> <li>Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH </li> </ul> <ul> <li>AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms </li> </ul> <ul> <li>B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Total cost of ownership and business case modelling </li> </ul> <ul> <li>The C4 model and diagrams as code </li> </ul> <h3>What we can offer you</h3> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only</strong><br>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.</p> <p>We lead with <strong>Heart</strong>, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.<br>We empower your <strong>Brains </strong>for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.<br>And we champion <strong>Courage</strong>, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than title: Staff Product Manager
description: Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) The Mission At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution. We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output. We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster. You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why. What you will own You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact. Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers Who you are You are a full-stack product thinker. Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results. Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking. Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower. Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait. Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project. The Role You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why. You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go. You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line. You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes. If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints. Why Fyxer? We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization. Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them. Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company. Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage. #LI-FYX Compensation: £140K – £180K • £140K – £180K Equity • £140K – £180K • £140K – £180K Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Deployment Strategist
description: The Role Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that. We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises. As a Deployment Strategist , you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale. What You’ll Do You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests. Own deployments end-to-end —design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing. Hold the senior relationships —be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations. Find the value nobody has scoped —go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next. Define best practice for AI deployment —set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale. Shape our roadmap —bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build. You Might Be a Great Fit if You Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague Bonus Points Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings Compensation and Benefits At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer: Competitive Equity : play a real part in Magentic’s upside A salary of £100-110k Enhanced parental leave 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown In-office lunches provided Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes Hybrid London HQ (4 days per week onsite, with flex if you have appointments etc) Annual team retreat —a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build Our Interview Process We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet. Initial call (30 mins) : this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team. Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers. Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply. We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone. Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible. Responsible AI Statement At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission. title: Enterprise Account Executive - UK Public Sector
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SLSQ427R384</p> <p>At Databricks, we help public institutions use data and AI to improve services, increase productivity, and get more value from public data and technology investment. That means putting trusted, relevant insight closer to the people making operational, policy and service decisions, and building services that can evolve as missions, technology and delivery models change, rather than becoming tomorrow's legacy.</p> <p>Databricks is looking for an Account Executive to own and grow some of our most strategic Public Sector customers in the UK government delivering against their core missions. You will inherit an established portfolio of strategic government accounts, with a clear mandate to protect and expand that base while building new relationships across departments and agencies we do not yet serve.</p> <p>This is a succession role: you will step into relationships and momentum that already exist, building trust quickly with current stakeholders while developing your own view of where Data and AI can help solve the sector's most important challenges. You will translate national and departmental priorities into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable growth.</p> <p>Working closely with government stakeholders, internal teams, cloud providers, and strategic partners, you will deepen consumption in existing accounts and extend Databricks' footprint.</p> <h2><strong>The Pressures Shaping This Work</strong></h2> <p>Government's hardest missions increasingly require insight across institutional boundaries, without requiring those institutions, their accountability, or their data to be centralised. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions. You'll be selling into that reality.</p> <h2><strong>The Impact You Will Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Take ownership of an existing portfolio of strategic government accounts, maintaining continuity with current stakeholders and expanding usage of the Databricks Intelligence Platform.</li> <li>Build and execute a go-to-market plan for the territory, prioritising the departments, agencies, use cases, and partners most likely to create sustainable growth.</li> <li>Identify and pursue net-new opportunities across departments and agencies not yet engaged with Databricks, building pipeline alongside your existing portfolio.</li> <li>Develop a clear view of national and departmental priorities and translate them into compelling Data and AI value propositions, executive conversations, business cases, and qualified opportunities.</li> <li>Use data and evidence to continuously refine your territory strategy, testing assumptions about where demand exists and which use cases resonate, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.</li> <li>Map and engage the full range of buying centres within each account, building champions, guiding opportunities forward, and compressing decision cycles.</li> <li>Run a consumption-led sales motion, using demand plans to prioritise the highest-value use cases in each account and grow usage over time rather than closing one-off deals.</li> <li>Manage a portfolio that spans quick wins and longer, complex public-sector sales cycles simultaneously.</li> <li>Build and defend a strong renewal and expansion motion within existing accounts as a foundation for new growth.</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional and partner resources, including professional services, training, systems integrators, and hyperscaler co-sell teams, to maximise account impact.</li> <li>Represent Databricks credibly with senior government stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor who puts customer outcomes first.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We Look For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A strong track record of quota attainment or over-achievement selling into public-sector accounts.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build a territory-level go-to-market strategy from first principles, reasoning from the fundamentals of how the sector works rather than importing a playbook from somewhere else.</li> <li>Experience managing an existing account portfolio through a transition, building trust quickly with inherited relationships while also prospecting for new ones.</li> <li>Working knowledge of UK Government structures, national and departmental priorities, procurement frameworks, and how public-sector technology decisions are funded, approved, and implemented.</li> <li>Sales experience in cloud software, data platforms, open-source technology, Data and AI, or a related enterprise technology market.</li> <li>Experience selling usage-based or consumption-based models and co-selling with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.</li> <li>Comfort running both land-and-expand motions in existing accounts and greenfield business development across new departments and agencies.</li> <li>Experience co-developing business cases and building relationships with senior civil-service stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience using structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Value Selling, with disciplined and accurate forecasting.</li> <li>A willingness to challenge assumptions, your own and others', and use evidence to make better decisions rather than relying on intuition alone.</li> <li>Eligibility for security clearance; existing clearance is an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Digital Natives Account Executive
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SLSQ427R430</p> <p> Want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do everyday at Databricks.</p> <p>As a Digital Native Account Executive at Databricks, you are passionate about selling to high-growth, venture-backed companies. You will own a focused territory of 3 to 4 large Digital Native spending accounts with significant upside potential. title: Trust Communications
description: TL;DR Millions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. That’s why we’re looking for an exceptional storyteller to spearhead Lovable’s trust, safety, and security communications efforts. Why Lovable For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now. Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too. The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway. What you’ll do Build and own Lovable’s trust narrative. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned, new, and owned media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, and safety. You’ll shape the stories that highlight our commitments and ensure we show up in the conversations where trust in AI platforms is being decided right now. Be the comms partner to our security and trust leadership. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation. Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll build and run the playbook that lets us move faster each time. Build relationships with relevant media and creators. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them. Who you are You’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires. You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. You know who they are, what they care about, and how to earn their attention honestly. You’re voraciously curious. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be willing to understand how a platform like ours works well enough to describe an incident accurately and explain a safety decision without hand-waving. You write clearly and have keen attention to detail. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive. You also catch things others may miss. You’re calm, hands-on, and low-ego. You’ll draft the statements, build the media list, prep the spokesperson, and coordinate across teams yourself. You thrive in environments where the plan often changes and the pace is relentless. You have 6+ years of experience in communications , with significant time spent on trust and safety, security, or incident communications at a technology company. We care more about the right years than the number of them: judgment under pressure matters more than tenure. What you need to know This is a strategic but hands-on role with both proactive and reactive components. That means you’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, while simultaneously leading the charge on work that moves our trust narrative forward. The role itself lives at the intersection of several functions, and you’ll be the one finding the red thread among all that’s happening so we can tell a cohesive story externally. Lovable is a European company with a global audience. The trust story has to resonate outside of Silicon Valley and our home turf in Stockholm. Wherever you sit, you’ll work across time zones and build relationships with the teams whose work you’re talking about. Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn’t technically “yours” when the moment calls for it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Self Serve
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role Self-serve today represents a meaningful part of Paddle's revenue. This role owns the commercial mandate to grow that significantly. Not just to run self-serve, but to build the strategy for where and how it scales, and execute against it. We're hiring a Director of Self-Serve to take full commercial ownership of Paddle's self-serve motion, running and scaling it as a business line. Self-serve is a material and fast-moving part of our revenue, and it needs an owner who thinks in unit economics, not just funnel metrics. You'll set the strategic direction, and work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Demand Generation, Partnerships, and RevOps to align everyone behind it. Getting this right is a genuinely cross-functional endeavour, and your ability to bring people with you will be just as important as your commercial acumen. You'll operate with a small, focused team including engineering capacity. This is a role for someone who wants to build and run the engine hands on, not manage through layers. What you'll do Own the line. Carry the commercial number for self-serve end to end, from acquisition through adoption, to revenue and net retention. Own the unit economics, and how they improve. Set the strategy. Form a clear commercial view of where self-serve creates value, ensure Finance and Product alignment, and translate it into a plan the business can execute against. Own activation and time-to-value. Evolve who and how we onboard through self-serve, how we nurture them through lifecycle stages, and the in-product experience that gets them to value fast. Increasing volume while decreasing time-to-value, not trading one for the other. You fundamentally approach the self-serve experience as a product, running structured discovery and experimentation, not defaulting to only marketing levers. Shape the demand. Define the customer profile that makes the economics work and work collaboratively with Demand Generation on the targeting you need, co-owning a single funnel against a shared ICP. Orchestrate cross-functionally. Codify the work into clear streams with clear owners, influence the Product, Engineering, and Risk roadmaps, and run a regular business cadence that keeps people aligned on priorities and impact. Deepen partner integrations. Work hand-in-glove with Partnerships to turn distribution relationships into deep well-integrated channels, owning the commercial outcome of partner-sourced volume. Build and run the engine. Design and run the experimentation, tooling, and tracking to improve funnel codification, time-to-value, activation, and conversion using AI where it raises velocity and quality, applied to the right customer. As the motion scales, you'll shape the team around it. Make the economics stack up. Working closely with finance you own self-serve pricing and packaging as a lever, to ensure profitable scale. How you operate Go get the answer yourself. When something doesn't add up, you pull the data, run the analysis, and don't wait to be handed a conclusion. Self-reliance is core to how you operate, not a fallback when support isn't available. You interrogate, not just observe. Live the ‘five whys’ principle, with the ability to take a plausible looking number, trend, signal and stress-test it until you've found the actual driver, not the first explanation that fits. You default to hypothesis and experiment before you default to opinion or output, treating the funnel as something to be iteratively shaped, not just optimised within. Given a mission, you don't let go of it. You have a real hunger to find and unlock value you believe is there, working through blockers, organisational, technical, or data. We'd love to hear from you if you are Deeply experienced in a PLG or self-serve motion in a high-growth tech business, where you've built and owned the funnel rather than a sales-assisted or enterprise motion, and have been accountable for the number, not adjacent to it. A commercial operator who has owned a revenue line, channel, or segment. Someone who operates in founder mode with the instinct to understand the economics, not just the funnel beneath them. You think like a product manager: prioritizing ruthlessly, scope experiments tightly, and see the boundary between growth and product as something to work across. Fluent at moving from data to a commercial conclusion, with the discipline to separate signal from noise and turn analysis into a clear decision rather than a list of observations. A sharp critical thinker who interrogates the brief rather than taking it at face value, challenges assumptions (including ours), and is as willing to conclude "this isn't where we should be investing" as to confirm the plan. A genuine cross-functional leader who has brought structure to messy, multi-team programmes, influenced roadmaps you don't control, and run the cadence that holds a programme together. A credible presence in front of senior stakeholders up to executive level; you communicate with clarity and authority and can take a room with competing priorities to a clear decision. Equally comfortable operating at altitude and dropping into the detail, and always coming back up with a point of view, not just findings. Able to use AI pragmatically; dynamic onboarding, predictive scoring, real-time segmentation, as a means to commercial outcomes, not an end in itself. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. We're more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you'll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don't match every part of the job ad, especially if you're part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We're committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let's grow together. Why you'll love working at Paddle We're a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We live and breathe our values, which are: Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training. Connecting at Paddle We're a 'digital-first' company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations. We recognise that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration. Our Paddle hubs: In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub) In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada) In APAC : Singapore Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work. To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description. title: Senior Compliance Director – UK
description: About BJAK BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted. We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA. This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function. Why This Role Matters The Senior Compliance Director – UK will: Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services. Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements. Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices. Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders. Build compliance capability and culture across the company. What You Will Do Regulatory Leadership & Strategy Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements. Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision. Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies. Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly. Risk Governance & Compliance Operations Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance. Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps. Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance. Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised. Consumer Protection & Business Integrity Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation. Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight. Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards. Cross-Functional Support & Training Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution. Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models. Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities. You Will Thrive in This Role If You See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker. Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail. Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic. Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments. Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation. What You Bring 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech. Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements. Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred). Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators. Bonus (Nice to Have) Experience in start-up or high-growth environments. Previous SMF experience. Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces. Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance. Location Requirement This role is based in the UK . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week. Why Join Us Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform. Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale. Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation. Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities. Compensations Range We offer a highly competitive package , ranging from £100,000 to £150,000 , reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.
